name: Octo-Fiesta
description: A Subsonic API proxy server that transparently integrates Deezer as a music source. When a song is not available in your local Navidrome library, it is automatically fetched from Deezer, downloaded, and served to your Subsonic-compatible client. The downloaded song is then added to your library, making it available locally for future listens.

variables.name: Subsonic - Service
variables.description: The Subsonic-compatible music service to use (e.g. Deezer, Qobuz, SquidWTF)

variables.name: Subsonic - URL
variables.description: The URL of your Subsonic server

variables.name: Subsonic - Admin Username
variables.description: Admin username to perform actions on Navidrome server that require admin permissions

variables.name: Subsonic - Admin Password
variables.description: Admin password to perform actions on Navidrome server that require admin permissions

variables.name: Subsonic - Download Mode
variables.description: Determines whether to download individual tracks or entire albums when a track is requested.

variables.name: Explicit Filter
variables.description: Filter songs based on explicit content.

variables.name: Auto-Upgrade
variables.description: Re-download tracks when higher quality is available

variables.name: Folder Template
variables.description: Folder template for organizing downloaded files.

variables.name: Deezer - ARL Token
variables.description: Your Deezer ARL token for accessing Deezer content

variables.name: Deezer - ARL Token Fallback
variables.description: Fallback Deezer ARL token if the primary one fails

variables.name: Deezer - Quality
variables.description: Preferred audio quality for Deezer downloads. Remove to default to highest.

variables.name: Qobuz - User Auth Token
variables.description: Your Qobuz user authentication token for accessing Qobuz content

variables.name: Qobuz - User ID
variables.description: Your Qobuz user ID

variables.name: Qobuz - Quality
variables.description: Preferred audio quality for Qobuz downloads (e.g. FLAC, FLAC_24_HIGH, FLAC_24_LOW, FLAC_16, MP3_320)

variables.name: SquidWTF - Source
variables.description: The backend source to use for SquidWTF downloads

variables.name: SquidWTF - Quality
variables.description: Preferred audio quality for SquidWTF downloads. Qobuz: 27 (FLAC 24-bit), 7 (FLAC 16-bit), 6 (MP3 320), 5 (MP3 128). Tidal: HI_RES_LOSSLESS, LOSSLESS. AmazonMusic: FLAC_24 (24-bit), FLAC_16 (16-bit), AAC (256kbps), OPUS, ATMOS

variables.name: SquidWTF - Timeout
variables.description: Number of seconds to wait for a response from the SquidWTF instance before timing out.

variables.name: Yandex - OAuth Token
variables.description: OAuth token for API access.

variables.name: Yandex - Quality
variables.description: Preferred audio quality for Yandex downloads.

variables.name: Yandex - Language
variables.description: Language for the API responses. Curated playlists and some album titles will be translated into that language.

variables.name: Yandex - Include Unavailable Tracks
variables.description: Allow show tracks in search results, playlists and albums that are marked unavailable for listening

variables.name: Playlist Support
variables.description: When enabled, allows searching and downloading playlists. Starring a playlist triggers automatic download of all tracks and creates an M3U file

variables.name: Playlists Folder
variables.description: M3U playlist files will be created in {DOWNLOAD_PATH}/{PLAYLISTS_DIRECTORY}/

variables.name: Internal Downloads Path
variables.description: Internal path to downloaded files. Not recommended to change.

variables.name: App Environment
variables.description: Set the ASP.NET Core environment. Not recommended to change.

variables.name: Storage Mode
variables.description: Set the storage mode for downloaded files.

variables.name: Cache Duration (Hours)
variables.description: Duration in hours to cache files if using Temporary storage mode.

variables.name: Internal Port
variables.description: Internal port. Not recommended to change.
